dc_title_s: Aerial Imagery for Douglas County, WI 2022
dc_description_s: This project established digital 3-inch and 9-inch orthoimagery for Douglas County Wisconsin. The dataset consists of tiled orthogonal imagery produced from nadir images captured by Pictometry International between May 5-13, 2022. 3-inch and 9-inch resolution images are available for download from GeoData@Wisconsin - once downloaded, the resolution can be determined for individual tiles.
